effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When effects trash any of this Digimon's link cards, gain 1 memory.
link_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] By trashing 1 of this Digimon's link cards, delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon.
